Bahamas
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Washington or bythe Consulate General in Chicago, USA.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport YES Visa shall be issued in London
Service/Official passport YES
Diplomatic passport YES
Citizens of the Bahamas are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina. Visa shall be issued in Washington or Chicago, USA.
